name: category.idIn
title: Field: category.idIn
description: Meaning of the any-of category id filter.
meaning: Matches any category whose id is included in the provided list.
text:
# category.idIn

TL;DR:
- category.idIn narrows category search to a known set of category ids.

Agent hint:
- Use this when category ids are already known and you want to re-read or narrow that exact subset.
